name: OpenClaw
description: Self-hosted gateway that bridges chat platforms (Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, and more) to AI agents, with a local Control UI.

notes.text: The Control UI listens on 127.0.0.1:18789 (local only). Reach it via SSH tunnel (ssh -L 18789:127.0.0.1:18789 root@<ip>) or Tailscale.
Onboarding is skipped on install. Run 'openclaw onboard' as the openclaw user (su - openclaw) or use the dashboard to connect channels.
